annotations.text:
Gantry UI v2 — cleaner light system, multi-project board.
Board: columns are normalized phases shared across projects; each card carries its project dot and native state. Amber = needs your input (strip at top aggregates across projects).
Drawer: waiting-on-you banner with actions, gate ladder incl. a human gate, events, adapter extension slot.
Swimlane: 'you' are a lane — the amber dashed span is time blocked on your decision.
